newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's carrier Garuda posts profit in '96.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's carrier Garuda posts profit in '96.

text.p: National carrier PT Garuda Indonesia posted a profit of 124 billion rupiah ($52.3 million) in 1996 but most of the gains came from asset sales, Transport Minister Haryanto Danutirto said on Monday.
He said Garuda suffered an operating loss of 87.44 billion rupiah in 1996, compared with an operating loss of 342.79 billion in 1995 but an overall profit of 135.79 bilion rupiah.
Danutirto did not say if the 1995 and 1996 profits were gross or after tax.
He said the airline, which is scheduled to be listed on the local stock exchange in 1998, had sold its "unneccessary" assets and would focus on its core business in the future.
"Garuda posted a profit of 124 billion in 1996, but the profits came mostly from the sale of assets," he told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
He said the government had paid 1.7 trillion rupiah of Garuda's debt in 1996.

"Garuda's debts total 3.1 trillion rupiah. The government helped by paying off 1.7 trillion rupiah to help Garuda's debt to equity ratio," he said. "Garuda will still have to sell its unnecessary assets," Danutirto said.
Garuda operates around 60 planes serving regional and international routes.
